name: Souma Hajime
source:
A Ronin samurai who is freeloading at the Karyuu dojo.
He talks polity, but he can't trust anyone fully, however he still has a strong sense of justice and will back up what he says with his life if necessary.
He can tell fortunes with dice, like where people should be and future prospects.
